newsitem.title: USA: HURCO IN LICENSING PACT, SEES Q4 GAIN.
newsitem.headline: HURCO IN LICENSING PACT, SEES Q4 GAIN.

text.p: Hurco Cos said Monday its subsidiary, IMS Technology Inc, will license its interactive computer numerical control (CNC) systems patent to Amada Metrecs Co Ltd and affiliates for a one-time payment of $1.2 million.
The license, after taxes and expenses, will raise Hurco's net income by about $680,000 or $0.10 per share in the company's fiscal fourth quarter ending October 31, it said.
It said the licensing relates to a patent that is the subject of several patent infringement lawsuits brought by IMS. Amada is not a defendant in those actions, Hurco said.
Hurco said that to date, settlements with defendants in the lawsuits and licenses to other companies that are not defendants have yielded gross payments to IMS of about $16.2 million.
Of this amount, Hurco said it realized net proceeds of $8.1 million and will realize an additional $1.9 million in future net proceeds through 2001.
